name: motif_add_lexical_entry
description:
Author a lexical entry. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if the morpheme is new to the lexicon; otherwise add a form, sense or analysis to its entry. Classify an affix as inflectional or derivational. If you see whole words for a regular derivation, author the affix (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages one new dictionary entry with its lexeme form, one sense with gloss and optional definition, and grammatical info: a stem, or an inflectional, derivational or unclassified affix. An inflectional affix can name the inflection classes its form attaches to; use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational affix. Inspect its Dry Run and try words with it before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-lexical-entry. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

form.description: The lexeme form, without affix hyphens.

form_ws.description: Vernacular writing system tag of the form.

morph_type.description: Canonical id of the morph type, such as stem, root, prefix or suffix.

analysis_ws.description: Analysis writing system tag of the gloss and definition.

inflection_classes.description: Affix only: canonical ids of the inflection classes of the stems this form attaches to; omit for no restriction.

environments.description: Canonical ids of the phonological environments this form occurs in; omit for any.

kind.description: Grammatical info (MSA) kind; must match the morph type.

category.description: Canonical id of the part of speech; for a derivational affix, the one it attaches to.

toCategory.description: Derivational only: canonical id of the part of speech it makes.

slots.description: Inflectional only: canonical ids of existing slots the affix fills.

inflectionClass.description: Stem only: canonical id of its inflection class, such as a noun class.

exceptionFeatures.description: Stem only: canonical ids of existing exception features the analysis carries.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
